items.nist-ai-rmf-10::govern: The GOVERN function: establish expectations for AI risk management, policies, roles and accountability, so trustworthy AI is embedded in organizational culture and risk processes (voluntary framework).
items.nist-ai-rmf-10::map: The MAP function: contextualize the AI use-case — establish the environment, intended purposes and stakeholder expectations, and categorize the AI risks that apply to this system (voluntary framework).
items.nist-ai-rmf-10::measure: The MEASURE function: develop and implement quantitative and qualitative measures of AI system performance, including effectiveness, safety and reliability, and evaluate the system against them (voluntary framework).
items.nist-ai-rmf-10::manage: The MANAGE function: prioritize, document and implement risk responses — treatment, mitigation and continuous monitoring of the AI system throughout its lifecycle (voluntary framework).
